handler_dispositions.limitation: Bounded SOL and synthetic USDC Token/Token2022 quote paths, configured creator fee/gross-spend truncation, funded completion using actual base-vault balances, optional fills and Mayhem crossing. Nested routes, transfer-fee extensions and exhaustive account validation remain unresolved.
SOL and USDC quote branches, Mayhem/holder fields and cashback rejection. Other quote routes and exhaustive extension/account validation remain incomplete; final event suffix uninterpreted.

Normal SOL and admitted quote creation, holder/quote-control/configured-fee paths, plus ordinary Tokenkeg curve/Pool ancestry source with finite depth1–5 validation. New16cases include15successes/one6105rollback and exact cap/depth diagnostics; pre-existing canonical ancestry is synthetic. Mayhem, exhaustive ancestry/error/input coverage, and new Token-2022 ancestry/extension modes remain unresolved.

One native curve per genuine AMM-signed Pump CPI with flag 3, plus exactly SOL→A→B and B→A→SOL using ordinary Tokenkeg accounts and flags [1,2]/[2,1]. The two-curve paths require canonical pre-existing vaults, a native root storing quote zero, ordinary 166-byte curves and strictly non-completing buys. Broader routes, other quote currencies, arbitrary hop counts, Token-2022/extensions, holder/cashback/Mayhem modes and completion remain unsupported. The retained 56-case one-curve subset has 50 Pump CPI comparisons and 11 successes; the new 20-case subset has 18 Pump CPI comparisons and 16 successes.
